(A) Carving, gouging, and slicing gashes, fissures, and textures into a wet clay or wax matrix
(B) Casting a durable plaster or cement negative mould from the scarred clay matrix
(C) Pressing wet, handmade rag paper pulp (cotton/linen slurry) firmly into the scarred mould

topic: Santhal Family Sculpture Material and Medium
questionText:
Given below are two statements:
Statement I: Ramkinkar Baij created the groundbreaking modern sculpture 'Santhal Family' (1938) using local river pebbles, sand, and cement cast directly in open air.
Statement II: Ramkinkar Baij carved 'Santhal Family' out of a single block of imported white Italian Carrara marble.

In the light of the above statements, choose the most appropriate answer from the options given below:

options.text: Both Statement I and Statement II are correct
options.mistakeAnalysis: Assumed both statements were correct.

options.text: Both Statement I and Statement II are incorrect
options.mistakeAnalysis: Rejected valid NCERT facts erroneously.

options.text: Statement I is correct but Statement II is incorrect
options.mistakeAnalysis: Failed to recognize error in Statement II.

options.text: Statement I is incorrect but Statement II is correct
options.mistakeAnalysis: Correct answer. Statement I is false while Statement II is factually sound.

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
Statement I is correct: Ramkinkar utilized local sand, gravel, and cement to build the sculpture directly outdoors at Santiniketan. Statement II is incorrect: he rejected expensive imported salon marble, pioneering modern public sculpture in humble local cement.
Hence Option A is correct.
Hence, option (D) is correct.
